target_selection_criteria: Start from 15-30 popular public AI/devtool repositories with active merged PR traffic.
Fetch recent merged public PR bodies only; do not fetch private repos or raw external repo contents into git.

Prefer PR bodies with agent/receipt-ish language: agent, Codex, Claude, Copilot, generated, validation, tests pass, pytest, make, benchmark, metric, score, updated, added, changed, or issue/file/test/commit reference patterns.
Allow bounded fallback to recent merged PR bodies when a repo has fewer filter matches so sparse PR-body prevalence is measured honestly.
Run report mode only. No outreach, maintainer contact, comments, external PRs/issues, enforcement, or model calls. No target project tests/builds.

fetch_policy.tool: gh pr list over public repositories
fetch_policy.committed_outputs: aggregate JSON/Markdown only; no raw PR bodies, raw API JSON, raw resolver receipts, temp paths, or external repo contents
